description:
Demolition of existing conservatory and detached garage.  Erection of single storey rear and side extension. Raising roof ridge and erection of rear hip to gable, and rear and side dormer roof extensions with installation of 1no. front rooflight to facilitate loft conversion.  Existing rear terrace rebuilt with amended site levels and extended section and new privacy screens either side to a minimum height of 1.7metres
Minor works to front garden
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to commencement of the development to which this permission relates, detailed design  of the proposed  privacy screens  to be positioned either end of the proposed raised terrace  along the site boundaries of neighbouring nos 17 and 21 Cranes Park Avenue, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers and ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The works shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with the deposited  Reasonable Exception Statement  compliant with Policy D12(A).Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire Safety) of the London Plan 2021.
